text:
Mia Chen: Heads up — on the HF->Redwood conversion for model-x-3b I’m seeing outputs missing the very first tokens in chat mode. Looks like BOS/EOS/PAD ids got shuffled during the conversion.
Samira Patel: Ugh. Can you paste the tokenizer special token ids and the conversion command you used?
Mia Chen: Sure. Conversion command: `scripts/convert_hf_to_rw.py --model-dir /mnt/models/model-x-3b --out /deploy/model-x-3b/rw`
Mia Chen: Tokenizer snippet from HF repo:
```
{"bos_token":"<s>", "eos_token":"</s>", "pad_token":"<pad>", "unk_token":"<unk>", "added_tokens":["<special1>","<special2>"]}
```
Samira Patel: And what does Redwood see after conversion?
Mia Chen: After conversion the RW tokenizer reports: `'<s>': 0, '</s>': 1, '<pad>': 1, '<unk>': 2` — pad ended up colliding with eos (id 1). That explains dropped leading tokens in the chat pipeline.
TokenChecker Bot: Automated scan report: duplicate token id detected for tokens ['</s>', '<pad>'] at id=1. Source: tokenizer.json vs added_tokens.json mismatch during `tokenizer.save_pretrained` step.
Jon Reyes: Possible cause: ordering difference when `added_tokens.json` is present vs absent. HF's `tokenizer.json` can contain explicit id mappings but some conversion scripts rebuild vocab from `vocab.txt`+`added_tokens` which assigns new ids.
Priya Nair: Did we quantize / export to ONNX in the middle of the pipeline? I've seen tools that reorder vocab when serializing.
Mia Chen: Yes — we ran quantize step after conversion to RW format. I can repro by skipping quantization and the ids remain correct. When quantize is applied the tokenizer mapping file gets regenerated by the script and the added tokens are appended without preserved ids.
Alex G: Can you paste the `added_tokens.json` produced and the tokenizer's `convert_tokens_to_ids` for the special tokens?
Mia Chen: `added_tokens.json` from the produced bundle:
```
[{"id":50256,"special_token":"<special1>"},{"id":50257,"special_token":"<special2>"}]
```
Mia Chen: But tokenizer.convert_tokens_to_ids(['<s>','</s>','<pad>','<unk>']) -> [0, 1, 1, 2] (pad == eos)
Samira Patel: Ok that’s consistent with the collision. Quick mitigation: abort the quantize/regeneration step and preserve the original `tokenizer.json` from HF. We should also assert special token ids right after conversion.
Jon Reyes: Long term we need deterministic validation in the conversion CI: assert that for every special token in HF config.json, the resulting tokenizer preserves the same id. Example unit test: `assert hf_tokenizer.convert_tokens_to_ids(special_tokens) == rw_tokenizer.convert_tokens_to_ids(special_tokens)`
Priya Nair: Also add a check for duplicate ids: `len(set(ids)) == len(ids)` for the special subset.
TokenChecker Bot: Quick fix applied to sandbox: re-run conversion preserving `tokenizer.json`. Result: specials preserved, no collision.
Mia Chen: Re-running full pipeline with that fix shows chat outputs restored. But we should handle the case where HF `tokenizer.json` is missing and conversion needs to reconstruct mappings.
Alex G: For reconstruction, the script must map added tokens to explicit ids using HF's `added_tokens.json` (if present) rather than appending them in arbitrary order. Also normalize on `tokenizer.save_pretrained()` output shape.
Jon Reyes: I pushed a prototype change to `scripts/convert_hf_to_rw.py`: when `tokenizer.json` exists, copy it verbatim; else, load `vocab`, then apply `added_tokens.json` entries using their `id` if provided, otherwise raise and request manual review.
Mia Chen: Can you add an automated regression test? Reproducer: take model-x-3b HF tarball, run convert->quantize->deploy and assert that `convert_tokens_to_ids(['<pad>','<s>','</s>'])` equals the HF baseline.
Samira Patel: I'll add the test to the onboarding checks and gate the quantize step. Also adding an integration test that runs a short chat evaluation (2-turn) to catch leading-token-loss.
Priya Nair: Note for ops: when hitting customer reports about "missing first word" prefer checking token id collision early — quick triage command: `python -c "from transformers import AutoTokenizer; t=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('path'); print({k:t.convert_tokens_to_ids([k]) for k in ['<s>','</s>','<pad>','<unk>']})"`
Mia Chen: Action items: @Jon Reyes to open PR for conversion script, @Samira Patel to add CI test, @Alex G to update docs/howto for HF artifacts preservation. I'll run a small sweep of recent conversions to find other affected models.
Samira Patel: I'll add a lint that fails if any special token id is reused. :thumbsup:
Alex G: Thanks everyone — good catch. :eyes:
Mia Chen: Happy path now validated in sandbox. Scheduling a canary redeploy to dedicated tonight.
TokenChecker Bot: Canary redeploy scheduled at 2026-03-21T02:30:00Z (job #4427).
